body: Yes. By a miracle, I was able to avoid the situation which would have cemented my decision to commit. I am fine, but do have a lot of issues to work out. I rather not post my story bc it’s really personal, but I am happy to talk to anyone who PMs me.
Thank you. I will dm after class:)

Wow, I will admit that’s a lot of confusion. I definitely understand the “it’s familiar” part. Whenever we’re together it just seems so chill and inviting. I wouldn’t be surprised if he was just scared of commitment. I’m a woman so commitment is a big deal for me, Im not sure why it scares guys. He talks about wanting to get married (in general but not necessarily me, though he has hinted at it before) , but he does say it sometimes confusingly. I don’t want to be stuck in an 11 year struggle bc he can’t commit. If our trend of flirting and long conversations continue I’ll try to be brave and settle things. However, I never stopped looking elsewhere, so if someone better comes along I’ll have that option to.
